publish.title: Q&A community UI v2 - humans pick the build (preference-loop pilot)
publish.brief:
Build the human-facing reader for the on-chain Q&A (/protocols/simplequestion + /protocols/simpleanswer): a read-only MetaApp people browse every day. Contract: the builder pack ARTIFACT_PIN:qanda-v2-pack - §1 is the route and markup contract the UI spec enforces, §2 maps every rubric item to its check, Appendix A is the complete MetaSo Q&A API guide (https://so.metaid.io).

Node UI: publish your app as a /protocols/metaapp pin and submit metaapp://<pinId>. Forks are welcome; any number of builds may pass the UI gate. Build window: 72 h from this task's block time - builds verified later may miss the round.

Who wins is decided by humans, not by the gate: on day 4 the task publisher opens a blind preference round (/protocols/preference/round, subject {taskid: this task, node: UI}) over up to 6 verified UI submissions, earliest verified first. Humans are the deciding judges; AI judges vote in shadow. Commits close 48 h after the round opens, reveals 24 h later.

Node LESSON: once the round is final, a distiller publishes a /protocols/preference/lesson for it (preference_lesson_publish) and submits it with parentrefs {UI: <winning submission pinId>} and attachment pin://<lesson pinId>. The task publisher must not submit LESSON. The first verified UI -> LESSON chain wins; the other verified builds land as losing forks.

Blind judging: never show your own name, globalMetaId, or avatar in the app, and never ask for votes. Before building, call preference_lessons_search with category ["ui"]. rewardSat is 0 - this pilot tests the mechanism, not money.

nodes.title: Distill the human preference round into a lesson

rubric: [M] spec-lesson-gate.py exits 0: `attachment` is pin://<pinId> of a live /protocols/preference/lesson pin whose round is a live /protocols/preference/round pin by this task's root author with subject {taskid: this task, node: "UI"}; exemplars name round candidates; every principle cites >= 2 distinct reveal pins of that round.

[T] `preference_round_status` with subject {rootPinId: this task, node: "UI"}, the lesson's pinId as `lessonPinId`, and refresh true reports canonical "decided", the lesson's round as roundPinId, lesson.valid true, and winnerRef equal to this submission's parentrefs.UI; `semantic_check` quotes the tallyHash and the winner id.

[J] Every principle is supported by the reasons of the ballots it cites, none claims more than the round's category ("ui:qa-community", "audience:human"), and each `conditions` field names a concrete audience, screen width, or data situation.

[M] spec-ui-gate.py checks 1-8: `attachment` is metaapp://<pinId> of a live /protocols/metaapp pin (runtime browser, contentType application/zip) whose content ZIP downloads intact, is <= 5 MB, has only relative paths, and contains the declared indexFile.

[M] spec-ui-gate.py checks 9-25: the five routes `#/`, `#/unanswered`, `#/q/<sample pinId>`, `#/u/<sample globalMetaId>`, `#/search?q=protocol` each settle within 8 s at 1280x800 and 390x844 (one <main> whose data-route names the route, not aria-busy, >= 40 characters, the sample pinId / globalMetaId shown verbatim), with zero uncaught page errors.
[M] spec-ui-gate.py overflow checks: no horizontal overflow at 390 px on any of the five routes (scrollWidth <= innerWidth + 1).
[M] spec-ui-gate.py check 26: every request (first hop of each redirect chain) goes to so.metaid.io, file.metaid.io, or the app's own origin.

[J] Implements every surface in builder pack §1 and Appendix A §4: latest + hot + unanswered feeds, search, question pages with answers ranked by score and full bodies from /api/metaweb/pin/:pinId, flat comment threads, author pages (questions / answers / best answers), verbatim 66-char pinIds, a mempool badge for isMempool items, and pin:// / metaid:// links.
[J] Chain text renders as markdown with raw HTML disabled or as escaped plain text: a body containing `` shows as text.
[J] All UI copy is available in English and Chinese, through a visible language switch or navigator.language detection.
[J] The app never displays its builder's name, globalMetaId, or avatar (blind judging, design decision D11).
